default.description: The task's own workflow arguments, unchanged.

factory-fix.description: Factory at the fix tier (tierConfirmed skips the intake check) instead of the task's workflow.

pair-4-reviews.description: Pair with a review budget of 4 instead of 8.

ensemble.description: Ensemble in implement mode with its defaults instead of the task's workflow: on the standalone runner every turn is Codex Astra (setup, four solvers and their checkers, two review lenses each, and the advisory comparison: 18 turns). grade grades every candidate and heads the outcome with the advisor's top-ranked one.

smoke.description: For harness smoke tests only: proves prepare, run, grade, scan and evaluate end to end as cheaply as possible. Pair with a Codex Luna author and a Claude Haiku reviewer and spec review (setup follows the author), medium effort, two reviews, ten turns and no retro. Its results are not comparable with other variants.
